recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a male figure in red silk attire seated on a gold chair, framed by a stark white background and a bold vertical graphic band on the right containing a gold heraldic crest and serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered in the white field to the left of a dominant vertical stripe.
Gold accents in the jewelry and chair legs mirror the gold foil-style crest.
The red of the silk shirt coordinates with the red borders of the vertical graphic band.
High-key lighting creates soft shadows on the floor, grounding the subject.
coreInvariants: Off-white or bright white studio background.
Vertical graphic element occupying the right third of the composition.
Gold laurel wreath and crown crest motif.
Subject wearing sunglasses and gold jewelry.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body seated figure, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fit vertically with breathing room at top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical black and red stripe on the right acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face/sunglasses, moves down to the gold chair legs, then shifts right to the vertical crest and typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space surrounding the subject provides a clean, high-contrast look.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background) and Red (clothing and graphic borders).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds; metallic sheen in the gold; high value (brightness) in the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serifs and elegant scripts.
letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes in the serif fonts.
Roman numerals used for primary display text.
Script elements feature fluid, connected loops with a slight slant.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Roman numerals integrated into a laurel wreath crest.
Small 'K' superscripted next to large numerals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal serif paired with a casual but elegant script for a luxury aesthetic.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the graphic band

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the high-contrast serif look for the Roman numerals.
Matches the elegant, formal script used for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a red silk short-sleeve button-down shirt and matching shorts, wearing a white baseball cap, gold chains, and sunglasses, sitting on a gold-legged chair against a clean white background. Leave the right third of the frame empty for a vertical graphic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical black stripe on the right with thin red borders. Inside the stripe, place a gold crest consisting of a crown and laurel wreath. Center large gold serif Roman numerals inside the wreath, with script text above and below.

verificationChecks: Is the vertical stripe perfectly aligned to the right?
Is the gold texture consistent across jewelry and typography?
Does the subject's pose feel relaxed yet confident?

adjustableVariables: Specific clothing pattern (e.g., stripes vs solid)
Width of the vertical graphic band
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the hat or clothing
Japanese text on the side spine (obi strip)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold crest doesn't look like a generic clip-art.
Check that the red in the clothing matches the red in the graphic band.
Verify the shadow on the floor is soft and realistic.
Confirm the Roman numerals are legible and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + White Negative Space + Vertical Graphic Band + Gold Heraldic Typography
